'''DM/C3''', operating under the codename "Dagger," was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was programmed by the Alliance to go undercover with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], operating as the personal decoding [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vanko]].
